en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting an industrial factory complex. There are two main buildings: a large rectangular brick building with many windows and a smaller building with arched windows. Some industrial structures, possibly related to energy or manufacturing, are visible in the yard. The area looks undeveloped and rural, with dirt paths and sparse vegetation. The caption at the top reads: 'Trollhättan. Elektrothermiska Fabriken. Stallbacka.'
